name: caption-with-intent
description: Open toolchain for the Caption with Intention design system: interchange format, reference spec implementation, renderers, and an AI analyzer.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @corerus/chorus-core && npm run build -w @corerus/chorus-web && npm run build -w @corerus/chorus-cli && npm run build -w @corerus/chorus-mcp
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:node && npm run test:py
scripts.test:node: node --test packages/core/test/spec.test.js packages/cli/test/tools.test.js packages/cli/test/render-conform.test.js packages/cli/test/studio.test.js packages/cli/test/team.test.js packages/mcp/test/server.test.js packages/web/test/renderer.test.js
scripts.release:dry: npm run release:check && npm publish --workspaces --dry-run --access public
